question: One-shot coding screen: inspect the proposed code and tests; no automatic qualification.

messages.content: Implement a Python function merge_intervals(intervals) for half-open integer intervals [start, end). Reject reversed intervals. Ignore empty intervals. Merge overlapping or adjacent intervals, preserve negative endpoints, return sorted non-overlapping tuples, and do not mutate the input. Include a small set of tests that distinguish these cases. Return code and tests.
